The Department of Homeless Services (DHS') is seeking appropriately qualified contractors/vendors to contract for the provision of shelter services for families with children, adult families, and single adults who are temporarily housed in DHS contracted commercial hotels. The selected vendors will provide services as outlined in this RFP to assist clients with their daily needs and to help them move out of the shelter system as quickly as possible.

The mission of DHS is to prevent homelessness when possible and to provide short-term emergency shelter for individuals and families who have no other housing options available. DHS primarily meets this goal by providing services to clients in long-term contracted purpose-built shelters throughout the City. When there are not enough available shelter beds and units in traditional shelters, DHS temporarily uses commercial hotels to house clients while they transition to permanent housing.  

Over the last 15 years, DHS has faced numerous crises which have forced DHS to rely on commercial hotels to temporarily house clients. Long term DHS is committed to phasing out the use of commercial hotels.

notices.agency_name: Mayor's Fund to Advance New York City
notices.description:
The City of New York (City) is working toward free, high-quality care and education for every child under five, delivered in a range of culturally competent care settings with educators and caregivers who are trained, respected, and fairly compensated. Under this vision, the Mayors Office of Child Care and Early Childhood Education (MOCCECE) seeks to ensure its as easy as possible for both providers to open, operate, and keep their businesses running, and for families to access and afford the care they need.

Licensed Family Child Care (FCC) and Group Family Child Care (GFCC) providers are central to this vision. These providers are among the most trusted people in their neighborhoods, offering care in the many languages spoken across NYC and serving as lifelines for the families and communities they serve. notices.short_title: RFB for Five9 Cloud Contact Center Services
notices.description:
MetroPlus is seeking qualified sellers/resellers capable of providing the required Five9 licensing and associated support services.


MetroPlus will leverage its existing strategic relationship with Five9 and build upon its current Intelligent Virtual Agent (IVA) investment to create a more integrated and cloud-based customer engagement environment. The target solution consists of the Five9 Virtual Contact Center platform, including bundled licensing and required add-on functionality for Verint Workforce Management (WFM) integration.


MetroPlus seeks a best-value solution that combines competitive pricing with proven Five9 expertise, strong service delivery capabilities, and innovative approaches that support long-term business and operational objectives.
